note.note:
I don't see the transcript or the DDx JSON included. I need both to generate the Problem List Clinical Note.

Please paste the full clinical transcript (doctor–patient conversation) and the DDx JSON. Helpful details:
- Include the entire verbatim transcript (labelled as "transcript" if possible).
- Include the DDx output (labelled as "ddx" or the JSON block).
- If any parts are redacted, mark them; I will note missing info.

If you prefer, you can copy both into a single message using this format:
<<<
{transcript}
>>>
<<<
{ddx}
>>>

When you send those I will prepare the consult summary, problem list, medications, allergies, PMH, social and preventive history, exam findings, plan, and quality checks per your specified structure.
